description: Source code for a Python class 'OpenOcdBinaryRunner' that manages running and debugging OpenOCD (Open On-Chip Debugger) with Zephyr RTOS. It includes methods for flashing, attaching, debugging, and version checking, with configuration options for ports, commands, and ELF files.

classes.name: OpenOcdBinaryRunner
classes.description: A class that extends ZephyrBinaryRunner to control OpenOCD for flashing, debugging, and version management in Zephyr RTOS projects.

methods.name: print_gdbserver_message
methods.description: Logs a message about the GDB server status and thread info support.

methods.name: to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string component to a number, handling dev versions.

methods.name: read_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the installed OpenOCD.

methods.name: supports_thread_info
methods.description: Checks if the current OpenOCD version supports thread info based on version number.

methods.name: do_run
methods.description: Main entry point to execute commands like flash, attach, debug, or load.

methods.name: do_flash
methods.description: Flashes a binary file to the target device using OpenOCD.

methods.name: do_flash_elf
methods.description: Flashes an ELF file, extracting entry point for resume command.

methods.name: do_attach_debug
methods.description: Attaches GDB to a running target for debugging.

methods.name: do_debugserver
methods.description: Starts OpenOCD in debug server mode.
